'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Ben Brummett DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Brummett]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' You're not going anywhere
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
